name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Goat of Terror

text.plain: This ivory statuette is one of a set of three unique goats. The Goat of Terror becomes a Giant Goat for up to 3 hours. The goat can't attack, but you can remove its horns and use them as weapons. One horn becomes a +1 Lance, and the other becomes a +2 Longsword. Removing a horn requires an action, and the weapons disappear and the horns return when the goat reverts to figurine form. While you ride it, the goat radiates a 30-foot aura of terror (DC 15 Wisdom). Once the figurine has been used, it can't be used again until 15 days have passed.
